headline: Investigation Request for Former SPK Chairman: Minister Şimşek Assigns Inspection Board
summary: Turkey's Chief Public Prosecutor's Office applied for permission to investigate former SPK chairman İbrahim Ömer Gönül for abuse of office. Minister Şimşek assigned an inspection board.
why: SPK is Turkey's Capital Markets Board, the regulator overseeing securities markets, so leadership probes affect market oversight and investor confidence.
